lesson.title: Finish the mirror picture
lesson.subtitle: P4 symmetry revision
lesson.objective: Complete a figure so it is symmetrical about a mirror line.
lesson.story: Part of a figure is shaded on one side of a mirror line.

steps.title: Match the marked square
steps.prompt: Fold along the dashed mirror line. Which labelled square matches the marked square X?
hints: A mirror image is the same distance from the mirror line on the other side.
Count how many squares X is from the mirror line, then count the same distance on the other side.
It is in the same row, the same distance from the line.
Choose the square that is the same distance from the line, in the matching row or column.

steps.title: Shade the other side
steps.prompt: How many more squares must be shaded on the other side to make the figure symmetrical?
hints: Every shaded square needs a matching square on the other side.
Count the shaded squares on the side that is already shaded.
There are 6 shaded squares, so the other side needs the same number.

steps.title: Count them all
steps.prompt: How many squares will be shaded altogether when the figure is complete?
hints: Add the squares on both sides of the mirror line.
Both sides will have the same number of shaded squares.

steps.title: Explain your thinking
steps.prompt: How do you complete a symmetrical figure?

choices.label: Give each shaded square a partner the same distance away on the other side.
Copy the shaded squares to the other side, keeping them in the same positions.
Shade only the squares that touch the mirror line on the other side of it.

hints: Think about a reflection in a mirror.
A reflection reverses the figure across the line.
Copying in the same positions makes a slide, not a reflection.
Choose the explanation about the same distance from the mirror line.
